proposal.observation: The round-1 unfolding correction resolved the upstream defect: recentring residual fell from 56.6 cm to 3.1 cm, depth NaNs fell to 10.8%, retention rose to 76.1%, and orientation remains canonical. The depth map is now rectangular and spatially coherent, but every one of the 11 prompt centres is still propagated fallback despite visible oblique joint traces; real-detection ratio remains zero, ring-count error is 0.1, and SAM segment-size CV remains high at 0.715.
proposal.failure_mode: With centreline and coverage now healthy, stage 4 is missing or rejecting faint oblique-joint evidence and falls back to a fully synthetic prompt row. This leaves an extra, weakly constrained ring locus and prevents prompt placement from adapting to the visible joint geometry.
proposal.rationale: Retain the validated cubic, densely sampled centreline and make a bounded stage-4 recovery attempt: lower the binary and oblique Hough thresholds, bridge longer gaps in fragmented joint traces, and relax the distance-pattern tolerance. The coordinated changes target the current identifiable bottleneck without changing SAM geometry while its prompts are still entirely synthetic.
